description: A PHP class defining the EntityDataDefinition for Drupal, including methods for creating entity definitions, retrieving property definitions, and managing entity type and bundle constraints.

classes.name: EntityDataDefinition
classes.description: Defines the data structure for Drupal entities, including creation, property definitions, and constraints management.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new entity data definition, optionally specifying entity type ID and bundle.

methods.name: createFromDataType
methods.description: Creates an entity data definition from a data type string.

methods.name: getPropertyDefinitions
methods.description: Retrieves property definitions for the entity, based on its type and bundles.

methods.name: getDataType
methods.description: Returns the data type string representing the entity and bundle.

methods.name: getEntityTypeId
methods.description: Gets the entity type ID from the definition constraints.

methods.name: setEntityTypeId
methods.description: Sets the entity type ID constraint.

methods.name: getBundles
methods.description: Retrieves the bundle(s) associated with the entity.

methods.name: setBundles
methods.description: Sets the bundle(s) for the entity definition.
